main_text.p: רתם Ligavit, Junxit: Imp. רתם המרכבה Liga vel junge currum, Mich.1.13.
רתם c. Juniperus: תחת רתם אחד Sub Junipero quadam, 1.Reg.19.5. & v.4. fœmin. est: Plural. רתמים Juni-peri, Job.30.4.

רתק Niph. נרתק Concatenari, Catenis jungi, aut vinciri. Futur. ירתק Concatenetur, Catena in-star jungatur, Eccles.12.2. sic Masorethæ legendum tradunt pro ירחק Procul amoveatur, ut in textu scriptum est. Tales voces observatæ sunt undecim, quæ leguntur per ת, & non sunt scriptæ per ת: Vide Masoram. Pyh.Præter. הרתקו Concatenati, Vincti sunt compedibus, Nah.3.10.
רתוק m. Catena: Funis, Ezech.7. v.23. רתוקות Catena, I.Reg.6.21.
רתת m. Tremor, Hos.13.1. propriè Chaldaicum est. Nam pro Hebræo רעד in Targum est רתיתא Exod.15.15.
שאב Hausit: Praeterit. וישאבתם־מים Et haurietis aquas, Jesa.12.3. Infinit. לשאב מים Ad hauriendum aquas, Gen.24.13.
משאבים m.p. Haustra, juxta quosdam, Judic.5. v.11. R.Salom. vult, esse Loca ubi hauriuntur aquæ.
שאג Rugiit, leonum proprium, sed aliis etiam per metaphoram accommodatur: Præt. אריה שאג Leo rugit, Amos 3.8. שאגו צורריך Rugierunt hostes tui, Psal.74.4.
שאגה[?] f. Rugitus, Jesa.5.29. Constr. שאגת כפירים Rugitus leonum, Zach.11.3. Aff. דברי שאגי Verba rugitus mei, Psal.22.2.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points and dagesh are not reproduced; only the consonants are given, as far as legible. The Hebrew in the second entry (תחת רתם אחד) and the Targum form רתיתא are copied from a small, faint print. The word in the last entry (שאגה) is doubtful and marked [?]. "Hos.13.1." is read from a blurred "Hof"; the long s has been written as s. Italic and roman type for the Latin glosses is approximate. Printed errors such as "Pyh.Præter." and "vult,esse" are left as printed, as far as they can be read.
